column1: # Player income + hud panel refresh batch
# Player: l() is multiplied by the player's building count and added to resources every tick
#   (WorldSimulator: resources += buildings * owner.l()), and World difficulty scaling multiplies
#   resources and l() by the same factor -> getIncomePerBuilding ; c(long) is its setter
#   -> setIncomePerBuilding. (The other two long/int accessors, c() and o(), have no reader whose
#   meaning is clear yet and stay obfuscated.)
# Panels: every UnitPanel subclass overrides a(Unit) to refresh itself from the selected unit, and
#   the base declares it, so the whole family is setUnit. The dialogs take their payload the same
#   way: ScoreDialog <- PlayerStatistics -> setStatistics ; SquadPanel <- UnitList + index
#   LoadingProgressDialog <- float/text -> setProgress/setMessage ; MessageDialog <- title / body /
#   lines -> setTitle/setText/setLines ; InGameMenu builds a button from (x, y, label)
